Level 17. Spend 6 ki to cast wall of stone.
Always-prepared spells by level: 3 ensnaring strike, speak with animals; 5 moonbeam, misty step; 9 plant growth, protection from energy; 13 ice storm, stoneskin; 17 commune with nature, tree stride.
Action: spectral vines try to hold a creature within 10 ft. It makes a Strength or Dexterity save or is restrained, repeating the save each turn.
Action: fey and fiends within 30 ft that can hear you make a Wisdom save or are turned for 1 minute. Their true forms are revealed.
You and friendly creatures within 10 ft (30 ft at level 18) resist damage from spells.
When damage would drop you to 0 HP, you instead drop to 1 HP. Once per long rest. You also stop suffering the effects of old age.
Action, 1 minute: regain 10 HP at the start of each turn, cast paladin spells as bonus actions, and enemies within 10 ft have disadvantage on saves against your spells and Channel Divinity.
Always-prepared spells by level: 3 bane, hunter’s mark; 5 hold person, misty step; 9 haste, protection from energy; 13 banishment, dimension door; 17 hold monster, scrying.
Action: one creature within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save or is frightened and nearly immobile for 1 minute. Fiends and undead have disadvantage on the save.
Bonus action: pick a creature within 10 ft. You have advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 HP or falls unconscious.
When you hit with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed right after, without provoking attacks.

name: Soul of Vengeance

summary.effect: Reaction: when the creature under your Vow of Enmity attacks, you can make a melee attack against it.

trigger: Your Vow of Enmity target makes an attack

summary.effect: Action, 1 hour: you sprout wings and fly 60 ft, and enemies within 30 ft are frightened if they fail a Wisdom save.
You gain proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner’s kit.
You have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that have not taken a turn in combat. Any hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
Spend 7 days and 25 gp to build a false identity with documents, contacts and a disguise.
After studying someone for 3 hours, you can mimic their speech, writing and habits. You have advantage on checks to avoid being seen through.
When you hit a surprised creature on the first turn of combat, it makes a Constitution save (DC 8 + Dexterity modifier + proficiency) or takes double damage.
You cast wizard spells using Intelligence. You know mage hand plus other cantrips. Most spells must be enchantment or illusion; one-third may come from any school.
Your mage hand is invisible. It can stow or retrieve objects on creatures, pick locks and disarm traps, and you can use it as a bonus action.
If you are hidden from a creature when you cast a spell on it, it has disadvantage on its saving throw against that spell.
Bonus action: use your mage hand to distract a creature within 5 ft of it, giving you advantage on attacks against that creature this turn.

name: Spell Thief

summary.effect: Right after a creature casts a spell that targets you, you can force it to make a save. On a fail you negate the spell and steal it to cast for 8 hours.

trigger: A creature casts a spell that targets you

summary.effect: You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields and martial weapons.
A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can add it to a weapon damage roll, or use a reaction to add it to its AC against one attack.
You can attack twice when you take the Attack action.
When you cast a spell with your action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
Always-prepared spells by cleric level: 1 command, identify; 3 augury, suggestion; 5 nondetection, speak with dead; 7 arcane eye, confusion; 9 legend lore, scrying.
You learn two languages and gain expertise in two of Arcana, History, Nature and Religion.

name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages

summary.effect: Action: gain proficiency in one skill or tool of your choice for 10 minutes.
Action: a creature within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save. On a fail you read its surface thoughts and can cast suggestion on it without a slot for 1 minute.
You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of any cleric cantrip.
Meditate on an object or a place to see its past, for up to your Wisdom modifier in minutes. Needs a short or long rest to use again.
Always-prepared spells by cleric level: 1 burning hands, faerie fire; 3 flaming sphere, scorching ray; 5 daylight, fireball; 7 guardian of faith, wall of fire; 9 flame strike, scrying.
You learn the light cantrip.

name: Warding Flare

summary.effect: Reaction when a creature you can see within 30 ft attacks you: impose disadvantage on the attack. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), regained on a long rest.

trigger: A creature within 30 ft attacks you

name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn

summary.effect: Action: end magical darkness within 30 ft. Hostile creatures within 30 ft make a Constitution save or take 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage, half on a success.
You can use Warding Flare when a creature attacks an ally within 30 ft of you, not only you.
You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of any cleric cantrip.
Action, 1 minute: you shed bright light for 60 ft and dim light 30 ft beyond. Enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saves against fire or radiant spells.
Always-prepared spells by cleric level: 1 animal friendship, speak with animals; 3 barkskin, spike growth; 5 plant growth, wind wall; 7 dominate beast, grasping vine; 9 insect plague, tree stride.
You learn one druid cantrip and gain proficiency in one of Animal Handling, Nature or Survival.
You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants

summary.effect: Action: animals and plants within 30 ft make a Wisdom save or are charmed by you for 1 minute, or until you or your allies harm them.

name: Dampen Elements

summary.effect: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 ft takes acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage: grant resistance to that damage.

trigger: A creature within 30 ft takes elemental damage

summary.effect: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, add 1d8 cold, fire or lightning (your choice) damage (2d8 at level 14).
While creatures are charmed by Charm Animals and Plants, you can command them as a bonus action.
Always-prepared spells by cleric level: 1 fog cloud, thunderwave; 3 gust of wind, shatter; 5 call lightning, sleet storm; 7 control water, ice storm; 9 destructive wave, insect plague.
You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

name: Wrath of the Storm

summary.effect: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft hits you: it makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d8 lightning or thunder damage, half on a success. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier, regained on a long rest.

trigger: A creature within 5 ft hits you

summary.effect: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, spend a Channel Divinity use to deal the maximum instead of rolling.
When your lightning damage hits a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 ft away.
Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, add 1d8 thunder damage (2d8 at level 14).
Outdoors and not underground, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed.
Always-prepared spells by cleric level: 1 charm person, disguise self; 3 mirror image, pass without trace; 5 blink, dispel magic; 7 dimension door, polymorph; 9 dominate person, modify memory.
Action: touch a willing creature other than you to give it advantage on Stealth checks for 1 hour or until you use this again.
Action, 1 minute (concentration): make an illusory duplicate of you within 30 ft. You and it give advantage on attacks against a creature both are within 5 ft of.
Action: become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or cast a spell.
Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, add 1d8 poison damage (2d8 at level 14).
You can create up to four duplicates with Invoke Duplicity, and move any number of them as a bonus action.

Always-prepared spells by cleric level: 1 divine favor, shield of faith; 3 magic weapon, spiritual weapon; 5 crusader’s mantle, spirit guardians; 7 freedom of movement, stoneskin; 9 flame strike, hold monster.
You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.
When you take the Attack action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier, regained on a long rest.
When you make an attack roll, add +10 to it after seeing the roll, before knowing the result.

name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing

summary.effect: Reaction when a creature within 30 ft makes an attack roll: add +10 to it.

trigger: A creature within 30 ft makes an attack roll

summary.effect: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, add 1d8 weapon-type damage (2d8 at level 14).
You resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.
You can Wild Shape as a bonus action. While shaped, you can spend a spell slot as a bonus action to heal 1d8 per slot level.
Wild Shape beast limit is CR 1 at level 2, then your druid level divided by 3, rounded down, from level 6. Flying and swimming limits are ignored.
Your attacks in beast form count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical damage.
Spend two Wild Shape uses to become an air, earth, fire or water elemental.
You can cast alter self at will.
After you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can ask for a d20. On a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table. The DM sets the result; enter it yourself.
Gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check or saving throw. You regain this after a long rest, or when the DM calls a surge after a spell.

name: Bend Luck

summary.effect: Reaction, spend 2 sorcery points: when a creature you can see rolls, add or subtract 1d4.

trigger: A creature you can see makes an attack roll, ability check or saving throw

summary.effect: When you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, roll twice and use either result.
Once per turn, when a damage die of a spell shows its maximum, roll it again and add the new roll.
Added to your warlock spell list by spell level: 1 faerie fire, sleep; 2 calm emotions, phantasmal force; 3 blink, plant growth; 4 dominate beast, greater invisibility; 5 dominate person, seeming.
Action: creatures in a 10-ft cube from you make a Wisdom save or are charmed or frightened (your choice) until the end of your next turn.

name: Misty Escape

summary.effect: Reaction when you take damage: teleport up to 60 ft and turn invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast.

trigger: You take damage

name: Beguiling Defenses

summary.effect: You are immune to being charmed. Reaction when something tries to charm you: turn the charm on it for 1 minute on a failed Wisdom save.

trigger: A creature tries to charm you

summary.effect: Action: a creature within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save or is charmed or frightened for 1 minute, lost in an illusory realm. You must concentrate.

Added to your warlock spell list by spell level: 1 dissonant whispers, Tasha’s hideous laughter; 2 detect thoughts, phantasmal force; 3 clairvoyance, sending; 4 dominate beast, Evard’s black tentacles; 5 dominate person, telekinesis.
You can speak telepathically to any creature within 30 ft that you can see. It needs no shared language, but must understand at least one.

name: Entropic Ward

summary.effect: Reaction when a creature attacks you: impose disadvantage on the roll. If it misses, your next attack against it has advantage.

trigger: A creature attacks you

summary.effect: Your thoughts cannot be read by telepathy. You resist psychic damage, and a creature that deals psychic damage to you takes the same amount.
Action: touch an incapacitated humanoid to charm it until remove curse or similar magic ends this. You can speak to it telepathically at any distance on the same plane.
Copying abjuration spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time.
After casting an abjuration spell, make a ward with HP equal to twice your wizard level + Intelligence modifier. It takes damage first. Abjuration spells you cast restore 2 HP per spell level.

name: Projected Ward

summary.effect: Reaction when a creature within 30 ft takes damage: your Arcane Ward takes that damage instead.

trigger: A creature within 30 ft takes damage

summary.effect: Add your proficiency bonus to ability checks you make for counterspell and dispel magic.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells, and you resist spell damage.
Copying conjuration spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time.
Action: create a nonmagical object up to 3 ft on a side and 10 lb that you have seen. It lasts 1 hour, or until it takes damage.
Action: teleport up to 30 ft, or swap places with a willing Small or Medium creature within 30 ft. Regained after a long rest or after you cast a 1st-level or higher conjuration spell.
While concentrating on a conjuration spell, taking damage cannot break your concentration.
Creatures you summon or create with a conjuration spell gain 30 temporary HP.
Copying divination spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time.
After a long rest, roll two d20s. Replace any attack roll, saving throw or ability check made by you or a creature you can see with one of them. Each die is used once.
When you cast a divination spell of 2nd level or higher, you regain one expended slot of a lower level, up to 5th.
Action: gain one benefit until your next rest: darkvision 60 ft, ethereal sight 60 ft, greater comprehension of language, or see invisibility to 10 ft.
You roll three d20s for Portent instead of two.
Copying enchantment spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time.

Action: a creature within 5 ft that sees or hears you makes a Wisdom save or is charmed and incapacitated until the end of your next turn. You can keep this up each turn. Once per long rest per target.

name: Instinctive Charm

summary.effect: Reaction when a creature you can see within 30 ft attacks you: it makes a Wisdom save or must target another creature within range. Once per long rest per attacker.

trigger: A creature within 30 ft attacks you

summary.effect: When you cast a single-target enchantment spell of 1st level or higher, you can target a second creature.
When you charm a creature, you can make it unaware of being charmed. Later you can reduce its memory of the last hours.
Copying illusion spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time.
You learn minor illusion, and it can create a sound and an image together with one casting.
Action: change the nature of an illusion you cast that lasts 1 minute or longer, while you can see it.

name: Illusory Self

summary.effect: Reaction when a creature attacks you: an illusion of you makes the attack miss automatically.

trigger: A creature attacks you

summary.effect: Bonus action: pick a nonmagical object in an illusion you cast. It becomes real for 1 minute. It cannot deal damage or harm anyone.
Copying necromancy spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time.
When you kill a creature with a 1st-level or higher spell, regain HP equal to twice the spell level (three times for necromancy). Constructs and undead give nothing.
You add animate dead to your spellbook. It raises one extra creature, and your undead have extra HP equal to your wizard level and add your proficiency bonus to damage.
You resist necrotic damage, and your hit point maximum cannot be reduced.
Action: an undead within 60 ft makes a Charisma save or is charmed by you. Intelligent undead save with advantage, and a failed save can repeat each hour.
Copying transmutation spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time.
Spend 10 minutes per cubic foot to change wood, stone, iron, copper or silver into another of these. The change lasts 1 hour.
Spend 8 hours to make a stone. The holder gets one benefit: darkvision 60 ft, +10 speed, Constitution save proficiency, or resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder.
You add polymorph to your spellbook and can cast it on yourself into a beast of CR 1 or lower without a slot.
Action: destroy your stone to transmute an object, grant a panacea, restore youth or raise a dead creature.
Take one feat at 1st level. Choose darkvision 60 ft or one skill proficiency. Your +2 ability score goes where you choose.
Learn one artificer cantrip and one 1st-level artificer spell, cast with INT, WIS or CHA. Cast that spell once per long rest without a slot. Gain one artisan tool proficiency.
+1 CON or WIS. Cook’s utensils proficiency. Meals on a short rest heal extra 1d8 per hit die spent; after a long rest, make treats that give temp HP as a bonus action.
Needs Spellcasting or Pact Magic. Learn one eldritch invocation you qualify for, and swap it for another when you gain a level.
Needs proficiency with a martial weapon. Learn one Fighting Style from the fighter list, and swap it when you gain a level.
+1 DEX. Proficiency with firearms. Ignore the loading property. Ranged attacks within 5 ft of a hostile creature no longer have disadvantage.
Needs Spellcasting or Pact Magic. Learn two metamagic options and gain 2 sorcery points, spendable only on metamagic. They refill on a long rest.
Your poison damage ignores resistance, and you can poison creatures that are immune to it. Gain poisoner’s kit proficiency; brew potent doses with the kit.
Add the die to an initiative roll or a Stealth check as you make it.
Swap places with a willing ally within 5 ft by spending movement. You or the ally gains the die as an AC bonus until your next turn.
When a creature moves into your reach, use a reaction to make one weapon attack against it, adding the die to damage.
Add the die to an Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion check as you make it.
After hitting with a melee weapon attack, grapple the target as a bonus action. Add the die to the Athletics check.
As a bonus action, throw a light weapon with an attack and add the die to its damage.
Add the die to a History, Insight or Investigation check as you make it.
Costs 2 sorcery points. When a spell attack roll misses, reroll the d20 and use the new result.
Costs 1 sorcery point. Change a spell’s damage type from acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder to another from that list.
Your patron gives a talisman. The wearer adds 1d4 to a failed ability check. Uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Eldritch Invocation: Bond of the Talisman

summary.effect: Needs level 12 and Pact of the Talisman. Teleport to whoever wears your talisman, or swap places with them.
You have advantage on Constitution saves to keep concentration on a spell.
Needs level 5 and Pact of the Tome. Write willing creatures’ names in your book, up to your proficiency bonus. You can cast sending to a named creature without a slot.

name: Eldritch Invocation: Gift of the Protectors

summary.effect: Needs level 9 and Pact of the Tome. Allies named in your book can drop to 1 HP instead of 0 once per long rest.

name: Eldritch Invocation: Investment of the Chain Master

summary.effect: Needs Pact of the Chain. Your familiar gains a fly or swim speed of 40 ft, hits as magic, and uses your spell save DC.

name: Eldritch Invocation: Protection of the Talisman

summary.effect: Needs level 7 and Pact of the Talisman. The wearer adds 1d4 to a failed saving throw.

name: Eldritch Invocation: Rebuke of the Talisman

summary.effect: Needs Pact of the Talisman. When an attacker hits the wearer, use a reaction to deal psychic damage and push it.
Needs level 5. Cast animate dead once per long rest without a slot.
Call a Beast of the Land, Sea or Sky. It uses your proficiency bonus and has 5 HP plus 5 per ranger level. Its stats are on Companions.
